library.name: RPS-42 radar panel (RADA MHR)
library.description: S-band AESA panel, one 90 deg face. Target acquisition: ~8 km on mini UAS, 3.5 km on nano. Four panels give 360 deg.

library.name: RPS-62 radar panel (RADA MHR)
library.description: Larger S-band MHR panel for wide-area surveillance. Roughly double RPS-42 range per 90 deg face.

library.name: KuRFS fire-control radar (Raytheon)
library.description: Precision 360 deg Ku-band AESA. Fire-control sensor for LIDS and Coyote; detects the smallest UAS class beyond 15 km.

library.name: EchoShield tracking radar (Echodyne)
library.description: Ku-band pulse-Doppler ESA panel, 130 x 90 deg field of regard. Group 1 UAS at 3-4 km, larger UAS to 11 km.

library.name: LSTAR / AN/TPQ-50 EW radar (SRC)
library.description: L-band 360 deg air-surveillance radar; the early-warning sensor in FS-LIDS. Small UAS near 10 km.

library.name: AN/TPQ-53 multi-mission radar
library.description: S-band counterfire radar with a simultaneous air-surveillance and C-UAS mode. Cues LIDS effectors.

library.name: IRIS counter-drone radar (Robin)
library.description: X-band FMCW 3D radar with micro-Doppler drone/bird classification. 5 km instrumented, 12 km long-range mode.

library.name: Ranger R8SS-3D panel radar (FLIR)
library.description: Compact perimeter panel radar; tracks up to 500 targets and cues EO/IR. Micro-UAS to 2-3 km per 120 deg face.

library.name: RfOne Mk2 RF sensor (DroneShield)
library.description: Passive RF direction finder for UAS control and video links, ~5 km on common links. Four units give 360 deg.

library.name: RF-360 passive RF sensor (Dedrone)
library.description: Omnidirectional passive RF sensor. Detects, classifies, and localizes drones and controllers by protocol signature, ~2 km.

library.name: Discovair G2 acoustic array (Squarehead)
library.description: Passive 128-microphone array with ML classification. Tracks Group 1-2 UAS by sound, including RF-silent drones.

library.name: Acoustic picket node (Sky Fortress class)
library.description: Cheap omnidirectional microphone node used in wide picket lines. Hears OWA engine noise at 3-5 km; cross-bearings form tracks.

library.name: Ranger HDC MR EO/IR (FLIR)
library.description: Mid-range pan-tilt thermal and color imager for visual identification of radar-cued tracks. 360 deg slewable.

library.name: Teleidoscope ML auto-track camera
library.description: Machine-learning EO/IR gimbal in the FS-LIDS and M-LIDS upgrade. Keeps fire-control quality track on small UAS.

library.name: Coyote Block 2 interceptor
library.description: Jet-powered kinetic interceptor with RF seeker and proximity warhead. Combat proven vs Group 2-3; ~15 km reach.

library.name: Roadrunner-M interceptor (Anduril)
library.description: Reusable twin-turbojet VTOL interceptor cued by Lattice. Loiters and returns if not expended. ~15 km planning value.

library.name: Anvil interceptor (Anduril)
library.description: Rotary-wing collision interceptor for Group 1-2 with low collateral effects. ~4 km planning value.

library.name: MEROPS fixed-wing interceptor
library.description: Fast fixed-wing interceptor with fragmentation warhead; Ukraine-proven vs Shahed-class OWA. 5-20 km envelope.

library.name: XM914 30mm gun (M-LIDS)
library.description: 30x113mm chain gun on RIwP turret firing XM1223 proximity-airburst rounds. Group 1-2 out to ~2 km.

library.name: LPWS 20mm (land Phalanx)
library.description: Land-based Phalanx 20mm gun with radar-directed burst fire, cued by KuRFS. Point defense to ~1.5 km.

library.name: SMASH 2000L rifle fire control
library.description: Computerized rifle sight for dismounted counter-drone fire. Group 1 quads inside 250 m.

library.name: P-HEL 20 kW laser (LOCUST)
library.description: Palletized high-energy laser, deployed since 2022. Hard-kill dwell defeats Group 1-2 at ~2-3 km.

library.name: DE M-SHORAD 50 kW laser
library.description: Stryker-mounted 50 kW laser prototype. Group 1-3 UAS at ~5 km planning value.

library.name: Leonidas HPM (Epirus)
library.description: Software-defined high-power microwave array; defeats swarms in a sector. ~1 km planning value, 120 deg beam.

library.name: THOR HPM (AFRL)
library.description: Containerized high-power microwave for base defense; near-instant swarm defeat inside ~800 m.

library.name: Dronebuster Block 3B jammer
library.description: Handheld directional GNSS and control-link jammer. Group 1 inside ~1 km, 60 deg beam.

library.name: Modi II EW jammer
library.description: Dismounted or vehicle electronic-attack system; denies GNSS and control links to ~2 km.

library.name: EnforceAir2 RF takeover (D-Fend)
library.description: RF cyber-takeover system: assumes control of the drone and lands it. No broadband jamming. ~3.5 km on supported protocols.

library.name: FAAD C2 (Northrop Grumman)
library.description: DoD-designated C2 for C-sUAS. Fuses sensor tracks, correlates the air picture, and manages engagements.

library.name: Lattice C2 (Anduril)
library.description: AI sensor-fusion and C2 platform. Autonomously detects, classifies, and tracks; cues Anvil and Roadrunner.

library.name: Picogrid Legion edge node
library.description: Vendor-neutral edge integration node (Legion with Helios/Portal hardware). Fuses local sensors into one picture.

library.name: MEDUSA C2 (USAF)
library.description: Government-owned, open-standards Air Force C2 for base-defense counter-sUAS.

library.name: Red air: DJI Mavic 3 (G1 quad)
library.description: COTS quadcopter for recce and improvised drops. Launched 2-10 km out; ingress 100-400 ft AGL.

threatProfile.routeIntent: Low overwatch orbit, then drop or spot for fires

library.name: Red air: DJI Mini class (G1 sub-250 g)
library.description: Sub-250 g quad for short-range recce. Low and slow, 30-300 ft AGL, frequent hovers; hard radar target.

threatProfile.routeIntent: Short standoff recce, 1-5 km launch distance

library.name: Red air: FPV 7-inch OWA (G1)
library.description: Racing-style FPV one-way-attack quad, 1-2 kg payload. Terrain-masked ingress at 10-100 ft AGL; terminal dive.

uas.emissionsNote: Analog 5.8 GHz video, ELRS 900 MHz control

threatProfile.routeIntent: Terrain-masked attack along roads and treelines, 3-8 km launch

library.name: Red air: fiber-optic FPV (G1, jam-immune)
library.description: FPV quad steered over a fiber-optic spool. No RF emissions; immune to jamming. Slower due to spool drag.

threatProfile.routeIntent: Terrain-hugging attack on rear-area targets, 5-20 km out

library.name: Red air: DJI M350 class (G2 quad)
library.description: Industrial quad with thermal payload. Standoff ISR orbits 5-15 km out at 500-3000 ft; also a light bomber.

threatProfile.routeIntent: Night ISR orbit with thermal payload

library.name: Red air: heavy multirotor bomber (G2)
library.description: Baba Yaga class agricultural conversion. Night bombing from 5-12 km standoff; drops several munitions and returns.

uas.emissionsNote: Custom links, often 700-900 MHz with repeater

library.name: Red air: CW-15 class VTOL ISR (G2)
library.description: VTOL fixed-wing ISR. Launches from any clearing 20-50 km out; long racetrack orbits at 1500-5000 ft.

library.name: Red air: Lancet-3 loitering munition (G2)
library.description: Rail-launched loitering munition cued by an ISR drone. Transits at 5000-15000 ft; fast terminal dive, up to 83 m/s.

uas.emissionsNote: Video downlink until terminal; some variants autonomous

library.name: Red air: Orlan-10 class ISR (G3 fixed-wing)
library.description: Catapult-launched ISR from 50-120 km behind the line. Orbits 3000-15000 ft for hours; cues artillery.

uas.emissionsNote: C2 and video links; multi-ship relay employment

threatProfile.routeIntent: High orbit over target area, artillery cueing

library.name: Red air: Shahed-136 / Geran-2 OWA (G3)
library.description: Delta-wing one-way-attack, launched in salvos hundreds of km out. Low river-valley ingress or 10-16 kft cruise with terminal dive.

uas.emissionsNote: RF silent en route; some variants add SATCOM or cellular

threatProfile.routeIntent: Stream raid along a corridor, minutes apart

library.name: Red air: Gerbera decoy / light OWA (G2)
library.description: Cheap foam decoy flown inside Shahed streams to saturate defenses. Same corridors and altitudes as the OWA it mimics.

uas.emissionsNote: Some carry emitters to mimic Shahed signatures

threatProfile.routeIntent: Interleaved in OWA stream as decoy

library.name: Red air: Mugin-5 converted strike (G3)
library.description: COTS fixed-wing conversion launched from improvised strips 200-400 km out. Autonomous GNSS waypoint ingress.

library.name: Red air: Mohajer-6 ISR/strike (G4)
library.description: Runway-launched MALE-lite. Cruises 10000-18000 ft inside ~200 km line-of-sight C2; releases small PGMs.

threatProfile.routeIntent: High ISR orbit with PGM release

library.description: Protected point. Warning time is measured to this location.

library.description: General annotation point.

systemPresets.name: FS-LIDS fixed site (LIDS class)
systemPresets.description: US Army fixed-site layered defense: four RPS-42 faces for 360 deg acquisition, KuRFS fire control, EO/IR identification, EW defeat, and Coyote interceptors under FAAD C2.

components.purpose: Non-kinetic EW defeat for small targets

systemPresets.name: MEROPS counter-OWA site
systemPresets.description: Counter-Shahed package: early-warning radar plus a forward acoustic line cue fixed-wing MEROPS interceptors through an expeditionary C2 node.

components.purpose: Fuses radar and acoustic tracks; vectors interceptors

systemPresets.name: Acoustic picket IADS (Sky Fortress class)
systemPresets.description: Acoustic-led layered defense with its own geometry: a wide forward picket line of cheap omni microphone nodes gives minutes of warning; a fusion node cues a short-range tracking radar and mobile gun trucks plus a jammer.

systemPresets.name: Distributed sensor mesh (Legion/Lattice class)
systemPresets.description: Expeditionary mesh of mixed small sensors (passive RF, compact radar, acoustic, sensor tower) feeding edge C2 nodes; graceful degradation when any node drops out.
